scene.note: Each line from the radio desk goes through your functions, which give back tidy new text and pick out what Rhona must see.

steps.note: A call sign comes in typed in small letters, with spaces and a line end around it.
The ends are taken off and the letters made capitals, each step giving back a new text.
The tidy call sign goes into the log, the spaces inside it kept.
A grid reference arrives with spaces between its letters and digits.
Every space goes, wherever it is, and the letters become capitals.
The log gets the grid reference written one way only.
One entry at a time is looked at, in whatever capitals it was typed.
Two questions are asked: does it start with the word urgent, and does it mention a casualty anywhere?
True or False comes back, and the True ones go to Rhona.
An entry is a call sign, a colon and a message, or sometimes no colon at all.
The first colon is found; when there is none, there is no message.
The text after the colon comes back without its outer spaces.
